title: Strava Segment Time Improvement by Weekday
dataSources: Rides (`ride:session`), charge sessions (`ride:charge`), ride exports (`ride:export`), surf forecasts (`surf:forecast`), ride incidents (`ride:incident`), segment efforts (`fitness:segment`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sports telemetry — Onewheel ride exports, legacy Boosted board logs, Surfline forecast snapshots, and Strava segment efforts — streamed to Splunk HEC via vendor exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fitness:segment weekday=* seconds_saved=*
| stats avg(seconds_saved) as avg_seconds_saved, count as events by weekday
| sort - avg_seconds_saved
description: Shows average seconds saved by weekday for segment-improvement attempts.
value: Average seconds saved by weekday helps compare segment-improvement attempts across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `seconds_saved` on `fitness:segment` events and normalize `weekday` so Splunk can summarize performance by weekday.
visualization: Bar chart of average seconds saved by weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps the average seconds saved for each weekday so you can see what works best for segment-improvement attempts.
